$Comment: Names the ziggfreedcommon:track_level reading for requirement lines. Param is a track id; the reading is the best level the player ever reached on it, which a prestige never lowers, so nothing it opened locks again. A track that names itself (Text.TitleKey) words its own lock lines ('Requires Mining level 10'). It changes only through the player's own track gains or a track reload (Volatility Player). For the current climb, which a prestige starts again, read ziggfreedcommon:track_climb.
